subject: Post-discovery: draft MAP and timeline options (asks inside)
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@clearskyhealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 12 Apr 2025 16:10:00 -0700
Subject: Post-discovery: draft MAP and timeline options (asks inside)

Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for the time earlier today. I pulled together an initial Mutual Action Plan (attached) based on our discovery: key milestones, suggested owners, and two target-close windows (end of Q2 and early Q3). High-level items included:

- Pilot scope definition (POC dataset access + privacy checklist) — suggested owner: ClearSky data team
- Dedicated eval run and perf baseline — suggested owner: Redwood Solutions (Aditya)
- Security/compliance signoff (KPI: SOC2 evidence review) — suggested owner: ClearSky security
- Procurement & contract execution — suggested owner: ClearSky procurement

I attached a working spreadsheet (2025-04-12_MAP_draft_v1.xlsx) and a short PDF of my notes from discovery. Can you do two quick things:

1) Confirm the internal stakeholders who should be on the MAP (I guessed Mike Chen for Data, and Samantha you as sponsor). If someone else should own procurement/security, please call that out.
2) Pick which target-close window you prefer: 1) Aggressive — close by 2025-06-30 (requires procurement + security review this month); 2) Conservative — close by 2025-08-15 (more breathing room for legal/redlines).

If it helps, Aditya can run an internal cost/throughput estimate for the pilot by next week once we lock the expected dataset size.

Next steps from Redwood if you confirm stakeholders: we’ll finalize MAP v1, circulate a one-page execution checklist, and set a 30-minute kickoff with stakeholders.

Best,
Karthik
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachments: 2025-04-12_MAP_draft_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), discovery-notes-20250408.pdf (PDF summary)
From: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@clearskyhealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mike Chen <mike.chen@clearskyhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Apr 2025 08:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: draft MAP and timeline options (asks inside)

Thanks Karthik — good summary and thanks for pulling that together.

A few notes:
- Confirmed stakeholders: me (executive sponsor), Mike Chen (Data / model owner), and I added Lydia Park (Security lead) — lydia.park@clearskyhealth.com. Please add her to the MAP.
- Procurement will be managed by our vendor ops team (I’ll introduce you to Julia Huang after we align on the MAP).
- We prefer the conservative window: target close 2025-08-15. June feels tight given our internal audit schedule.

Two asks for Redwood:
1) Can Aditya produce a short summary of required infra and a pilot cost ballpark? Even a 1–2 slide estimate is fine.
2) Please flag any mandatory third-party certifications you need from us beyond SOC2 (e.g., penetration test reports).

If you add Lydia and Julia to the thread I’ll get their quick commitments.

—Sam
Samantha Ortiz
Head of Product and Data, ClearSky Health

Karthik / Aditya —

Quick internal note: I can own the kickoff coordination and the MAP v1 hygiene (making sure owners/ dates are clean). Aditya — can you take the perf/cost estimate? If you can turn that around by 2025-04-21 we’ll be in good shape for the kickoff invite the week after.

Also: Laura -> please include a security pre-check checklist (SOC2 items + outstanding docs) in the shared drive link so Lydia can triage. I’ll add that once the MAP v1 is updated.

Thanks —Laura

Subject: Re: Post-discovery: draft MAP and timeline options (asks inside)

Thanks all — adding Lydia and Julia to loop.

Summary of agreed next steps:
- Confirmed target close: 2025-08-15 (conservative window).
- Owners: Samantha (exec sponsor), Mike (data/model owner), Lydia (security reviewer), Julia (procurement).
- Redwood owners: Laura (MAP coordination), Aditya (perf & cost estimate; due 2025-04-21).
- Action: Karthik to publish MAP v1 (update stakeholders + conservative timeline) and link the security checklist.
- Kickoff: propose 30-min stakeholder kickoff week of 2025-04-28 — Laura to poll availabilities.

Links/attachments: MAP draft v1 (attached), shared drive with security checklist: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2B_map_draft_SHARED

Can everyone reply with +1 if owners look good or note a change. Once Laura confirms an open slot we’ll send the invite and a brief agenda (current agenda: 15 mins scope & milestones, 10 mins owners & dependencies, 5 mins next steps).

Appreciate the quick turnaround — I’ll update the spreadsheet and recirculate.

Best,
Karthik
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
